product: Smart Routing now supports external models for coding agents (Beta)
tagline: In the Unity Gateway Managed Configuration beta, Smart Routing can route coding agent subagents to external models behind a model provider service.
what_it_does: In the Unity Gateway Managed Configuration beta, Smart Routing can route coding agent subagents to external models behind a model provider service. Add them to models.sources, alongside system.ai models if needed. Beta This feature is in Beta.
why_it_matters: Open Unity Gateway Govern Agent configuration.
plain_summary: In the Unity Gateway Managed Configuration beta, Smart Routing can route coding agent subagents to external models behind a model provider service. Add them to models.sources, alongside system.ai models if needed.
